title: The Alchemist of Garbage Collection
subtitle: Purifying discarded mana memory before dangling references poison the empire.
quote: A true wizard is judged not by what spells he casts, but by what memory leaks he cleans up.
excerpt: In the royal alchemical vaults, Grandmaster Vane brews distillation draughts to dissolve abandoned spell tokens and phantom objects before they trigger a catastrophic Heap Overflow in the kingdom's core.
body:
When an archmage casts a lightning bolt, the light fades in a heartbeat. But the memory allocation lingers forever.

In the subterranean cisterns beneath the Royal Palace of Ostrad, Grand Alchemist Vane wore heavy dragon-leather gloves and leaded goggles. Around him bubbled thousands of interconnected glass retorts, glowing in eerie shades of phosphor green, cobalt blue, and radioactive cyan.

Vane was the Kingdom's Chief Garbage Collector.

The Poison of Unreferenced Objects

"Young acolytes are reckless," Vane muttered to his raven familiar. "They instantiate five hundred fireballs to impress a princess at the jousting tournament, and never deallocate the elemental tokens. Where do they think the used mana goes?"

Without the Alchemical Sweeper, discarded memory references congealed into toxic miasma. In the old days, kingdoms fell not to barbarian hordes, but to sudden, unrecoverable OutOfMemory crashes that caused city walls to disappear into thin air.

Vane adjusted the silver valve of the Mark-and-Sweep Alembic.

"Step one: Trace the root references. If an object is not bound to a living soul's staff, mark it for the void.
Step two: Sweep. Dissolve the ego back into prime ether."

A blinding wave of emerald vapor swept through the glass pipes. Millions of ghostly, dangling spell fragments hissed, dissolved, and reformed into pure, crystal-clear spring water dripping into the central reservoir.

Above ground, in the sunlit halls, the court applauded another royal duel, blissfully unaware of the silent alchemist in the sewers who kept their reality from crashing.
